name: Hul
title: Son of Aram and descendant of Shem
summary: Hul was a son of Aram and grandson of Shem, Noah's son. He is mentioned in the Bible's genealogies as one of the ancestors of the peoples who descended from Shem after the flood. He is regarded as the founder of one of the Aramaic peoples.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Shem's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hul is listed as one of Aram's four sons in the genealogy after Shem, Noah's son, as part of the origins of the nations after the flood.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in the Chronicles' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Hul is mentioned again in 1 Chronicles as a son of Aram, in the review of the family lines from Adam onward.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Table of Nations
keyEvents.description: As part of the Table of Nations in Genesis 10, Hul represents one of the peoples that spread over the earth after Noah's time.

keyEvents.title: The Blessed Lineage of Shem
keyEvents.description: Hul belongs to the lineage of Shem, which was blessed by Noah. Through this line, the Semitic peoples and eventually Abraham's descendants would come.
